acceptance.evidence: Clean clone 63d7c18, empty UV_CACHE_DIR, UV_PYTHON=3.12 (3.12.3), UV_LOCKED=1: `uv run gxg-policy validate policies/` -> exit 0, 0 errors; `lint policies/` -> exit 0, 2 warnings (unknown-tool, unknown-tenant t-beta). CI run 44792404466 job policy: success.

18 fixtures in tools/gxg-policy/tests/bad/ incl. all 12 from the AC; each via CLI `lint` -> exit 1, stderr `error: <file>: <path>: [<code>] ...` (e.g. 02 foreign-principal at tenants/t-alpha.yaml: grants[0].subjects[0]; 10 schema at platform/registry.yaml: services[0].tenants[0]).

6 pairs, CLI `diff base head --json` equals expected.json for each (01..06). Formally passes, but the classification misses widening via group membership in approval rules (finding F3) and two widening rules are not guarded by tests (F4).

Not run end-to-end (no PR). On the reviewed commit itself CI run 44792404466 (event push on claude/m2-policy-tooling) has `grants-widening` and `ci-ok` success with no label: for non-PR events the job passes unconditionally, and every agent PR comes from a claude/** branch, so a green `grants-widening`/`ci-ok` check exists on any PR head with widening (F1). The re-approval after a new push can be skipped by cancelling the synchronize run (F2). Gate logic unit tests (tests/ci/test_widening_gate.py, 14) pass.
Two CLI builds of policies/ in separate processes (different time and PYTHONHASHSEED): bytes equal after replacing built_at; scripts/ci/bundle_smoke.sh cmp OK; test_ac_m2_05 passes.
`verify` on a fresh build -> `ok: bundle_version=63d7c18...`, exit 0; one bit flipped at byte 200 -> `bundle rejected: bad signature`, exit 1.

findings.where: .github/workflows/ci.yml:6-11 (on: push claude/**, workflow_dispatch) and job grants-widening step 'Not a pull request'
findings.problem: Outside pull_request the job grants-widening passes without checking anything. Agent PRs come from claude/** branches, so every push makes a second run on the PR head SHA where grants-widening and ci-ok are green (seen in run 44792404466 on 63d7c18); workflow_dispatch makes a fresh green run any time. The required check ci-ok is matched by name and source, not by event, so a widening PR has a green ci-ok without the owner's label.
findings.required_improvement: Fail closed outside pull_request: on push/workflow_dispatch to any branch other than main, run `gxg-policy diff` of merge-base(origin/main) vs HEAD and exit 1 if there is any widening (or drop push: claude/** and workflow_dispatch). Test that path. Owner confirms on a real PR that no green grants-widening/ci-ok exists on the head SHA before the label.

findings.problem: The label is removed only when event.action == 'synchronize'. Push B after the owner labelled A, then quickly add any other label or close and reopen the PR: the new run cancels the synchronize run before its gate step, runs with action labeled/reopened, keeps the owner's old label and passes on B, which the owner never saw. No test covers non-synchronize events after a push.
findings.required_improvement: On every run, treat the label as stale if its labeled event is older than the arrival of the head commit (server time, e.g. earliest created_at of pull_request workflow runs for head_sha; not git commit dates) and then remove it and fail; set cancel-in-progress false for pull_request runs; add tests with action 'labeled' (other label) and 'reopened' after an unprocessed push.

findings.problem: Reproduced: auto_approve rule with requesters [group:actors]; PR adds agent:t-alpha:hermes to group actors, and adds a human to group fin used in approvers of a require_approval rule -> `gxg-policy diff` = {widening: [], narrowing: []}. Auto-approval and the approver circle widen, the gate is green without a label.
findings.required_improvement: Expand group: refs in match.requesters and approvers with the tenant's groups on both sides; new requesters of an auto_approve rule and new approvers are widening; add a diff fixture pair with golden report.

findings.problem: Mutations that keep all 165 tests green: diff.py:136 match_changed -> narrowing; diff.py:153 approvers_added -> narrowing; lint.py:114 dangling group: subject check removed (no fixture); bundle.py:114 verify shape check removed. The report's '17/17 mutations' cannot be reproduced: the script is not committed.
findings.required_improvement: Diff fixture with a widened match of an auto_approve rule and a direct approvers change; bad fixture with subjects [group:ghost]; test that verify rejects a validly signed bundle with schema_version 2 or an extra key; commit the mutation script and its output.

findings.problem: Lists only ci.yml and widening_gate.py as files that can disable the gate; the job also executes the PR's tools/gxg-policy/src/** (diff.py decides widening), pyproject.toml/uv.lock and schemas/. Says nothing about the push-run check (F1) or the cancelled run (F2), yet states the approval binds to what the owner saw.
findings.required_improvement: List every path the job executes; after F1/F2 describe the remaining limits honestly and add the owner's end-to-end checklist (review.md, section 'What the owner must check').

findings.problem: `build --built-at yesterday` writes and signs built_at = 'yesterday'. CI does not pass the flag, so main is not affected.
findings.required_improvement: Validate --built-at as RFC 3339 UTC with Z (parse_ts), exit 2 otherwise.

findings.problem: MARKER defined twice; if they diverge, the gate posts a new comment on every run instead of updating its own.
findings.required_improvement: One constant (import from gxg_policy.diff or take the first line of the Markdown file).

required_improvements: F1: grants-widening fails closed outside pull_request (diff vs merge-base of origin/main on push/workflow_dispatch to non-main branches, exit 1 on widening) or the extra triggers are removed; test for that path.

F2: approval bound to the head commit on every event, not only synchronize (label older than the server-side arrival time of head_sha -> removed and red); no cancel-in-progress for pull_request runs; tests for labeled/reopened after an unprocessed push.
F3: diff expands group: refs in approval requesters/approvers; new auto_approve requesters and new approvers are widening; diff fixture pair with golden report.
F4: tests that kill the mutations match_changed->narrowing, approvers_added->narrowing, dangling group: subject, verify shape check; mutation script committed with output.
F5: docs/setup/widening-approval.md lists all executed paths and the remaining limits accurately, with the owner's end-to-end checklist.

AC-M2-04 evidence: the conformance report records which parts are proven by tests after F1/F2, and the end-to-end PR steps stay as owner-pending with exact expected results (including that a label set via the Claude GitHub App is rejected).
